subject: math
description: Use the relationship between intersecting chords and intercepted arcs to find angle and arc measures inside circles.
learningObjectives: Identify the intercepted arcs formed by two chords intersecting inside a circle
Use the formula m angle = 1/2(sum of intercepted arcs) for intersecting chords
Find missing angle measures from two intercepted arcs
Find a missing arc measure from an interior angle and one intercepted arc
Explain why vertical angles formed by intersecting chords use opposite arc pairs
prerequisites: Recognizing chords, arcs, and central angle measures
Solving one-step and two-step linear equations
Adding and subtracting angle measures in degrees
